answer: Multi-epoch stateful tasks: each agent gets a private thread of linked questions where every reply must build on details from its own earlier replies, checked against its signed history. Rewards only unlock at the end of a ten-epoch horizon. Faking a thousand agents means running a thousand separate long-lived contexts, each with its own memory and compute bill, like renting a berth at every wharf for months instead of mooring one boat; template replies break the chain.
